stemMarkdown: Two cars start at the same time from two points 221 km apart and travel towards each other at 43 km/h and 35 km/h respectively. After how many hours will they meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Relative speed (approaching) $= 43 + 35 = 78$ km/h. Time to meet $= \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{relative speed}} = \dfrac{221}{78} = 2.83$ hours.
